requirements_summary: Workload mix: ~60% conversational support, 30% reranking (candidate scoring), 10% embeddings/offline. Steady-state baseline: 25 requests/sec aggregate for chat, average response ~120 tokens -> baseline ~3,000 tokens/sec. Typical reranking: 1k QPS equivalence in batch windows (128 candidates) but tolerant to slightly higher latency. Peak/burst profile: short bursts up to 250 req/sec (flash events) with shorter responses (~40 tokens) -> peak ~10k tokens/sec. Latency SLOs: desired p50 < 120ms, p95 < 200ms for chat; reranking p95 < 500ms acceptable. Cost sensitivity: wants reserved pricing to hit unit cost target < $0.008/token for steady-state. Preferred GPU families: A100-40 / H100 class; open to quantized M60-class for low-cost tiers. Operational needs: VPC/private control plane, SOC2 + SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs and 13 months of request-level retention. Fallback/availability: must have automated fallback to smaller model or hosted pool when reserved capacity saturates. SLA asks: 99.95% uptime on control plane, 99.9% on inference nodes, credits for sustained perf regressions or >= 10% deviation from latency SLOs.
